title: Eylsia Nicolas drops an apocalyptic anthem with "Not Gonna End Very Well mix"
htmlContent: The ever-capable Eylsia Nicolas delves into a funky lament on her new single "Not Gonna End Very Well mix." The track is positioned as a tongue-in-cheek anthem to the apocalypse, but instead of terror, it's throwing glitter on the exit sign.  https://open.spotify.com/track/46s6YfrWvo9WiiZNkpc4oa Nicolas's life will be coming to book form this holiday season, and a film project is now in serious talks. She has been forthright about turning loss into fortitude and, eventually, music, and you can feel that stance of resilience throughout this new song. The sarcasm is deserved, and it sounds like someone who has survived enough storms to laugh without wincing. The single is a raised eyebrow set to rhythm, playful, knowingly theatrical, slightly twisted in its humor, and bearing Nicolas's mark. It shrugs and winks, and cranks the volume. "Not Gonna End Very Well mix" comes on the heels of a phase of major forward motion in Nicolas's career. It sounds like the sort of song that gets penned only after one has gone a long way.
